test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 'DONKEY' is coded as '88' and 'SPARROW' is coded as '79', then how will 'PEGION' be coded?
solution:
The position of letter according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

**Logic: Addition of opposite value of given words = Number code**

'DONKEY' is coded as '88'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b55d4b3e153c0a24aa774a5f54a513cea802a5c9580ca33bbf1b9d7b3c10ee08.png] 

Addition of opposite value → 23 + 12 + 13 + 16 + 22 + 2 = **'****88'**

'SPARROW' is coded as '79'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fd69e63768942fc2b8e6be2a0aa46a92b3a5258a17161a0ee46db9db187360f.png] 

Addition of opposite value → 8 + 11 + 26 + 9 + 9 + 12 + 4 = **'79'**

Similarly,

'PEGION' is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55cda2e92e96ecfac1a117cef2b873a77733d6898913c706d096391d37f42e8f.png] 

Addition of opposite value → 11 + 22 + 20 + 18 + 12 + 13 = **'96'**

Hence, the correct answer is **"96".**
